_comment: Jacquard cosim testbench for the APB3 bus-trace test (ADR 0013). The design's APB master issues 2 writes + 2 reads to an always-ready slave, then idles. The bus_traces entry resolves the (kept) APB net names; cosim decodes the transfers and, with --bus-trace-csv, writes them as CSV. See tests/apb_trace/check.py for the pass criterion.
